post_title: What I Found When I Stopped Chasing More
meta_description: Mike Moll on Find It! With Debbie: the freedom he found by doing less, and why chasing more nearly cost him everything.
tldr: Chasing more led me straight into burnout.
I found freedom by simplifying, not by adding.
intro_html: Find It! With Debbie asks every guest a simple question. What have you found in life? It is an uplifting show about growth, purpose, and the things that keep us going. I came on to share what I found. For me, it was freedom, and it showed up when I stopped chasing more.

sections.html: For years I thought the answer was always more. More clients, more hours, more revenue. I ran a Google Ads agency and I kept pushing. Then a downsizing and a near-burnout stopped me. I had built something that looked successful and left me empty. That is a hard place to be, because from the outside nothing looks wrong. The lesson I found was that more is not the same as better.

I rebuilt the business around less. Fewer clients. Simpler work. Room to breathe. That choice gave me the freedom to travel and to spend my days on what matters to me. Freedom did not come from adding one more thing. It came from taking things away until what was left felt right. If you feel stretched thin, that might be the direction worth looking. I share more of the mindset side on the Fox Talks Business podcast.

about_blurb_html: Find It! With Debbie, hosted by entrepreneur Debbie Bettendorf, invites guests to share what they have found in life to help listeners find it too. Mike came on to talk about the freedom he found by simplifying.
